description: A4D-2 c/n 12234, ex USN BuNo 144988, received February 1972 as 0661/3-A-208, later 3-A-308, retired 18 January 1986; on a pedestal at the aero club gate painted as 0667/3-A-314 BuNo 145050 in memory of Lt Marcelo Márquez, shot down 21 May 1982. Photographed 2010 and listed October 2020.
museum_name: Aero Club Mar del Plata A-4Q Skyhawk Gate Guard, Batán
